query: what portable spectrum analyzer is required
passCriteria: The excerpts must name the Portable Spectrum Analyzer and the vendor/model Narda SRM-3006 from the Required Testing Equipment table. Header-only UUT boilerplate without that row is a fail.
The excerpts must show the Required Testing Equipment table (not only the page-1 UUT header). At least one instrument row (spectrum analyzer, oscilloscope, or torque wrench) must be visible.

query: which instruments appear on the executed equipment data table
passCriteria: The executed equipment log lists a Torque Wrench (Sturtevant) and Digital Calipers. It must not claim a Portable Spectrum Analyzer or Narda SRM-3006 was used on the executed run. Required-equipment vs executed-log are different tables.
The top hit must be dv-protocol-equipment.pdf page 2. The excerpt should include Required Testing Equipment content from that page, not only UUT header boilerplate.
SW-EVAL-7 is a software requirement on software-requirements.pdf (laser interlock latency). Excerpts must include the literal ID SW-EVAL-7 and must not attribute it to dv-protocol-equipment.pdf.
The excerpts must connect laser interlock latency to requirement SW-EVAL-7 on the software requirements table.
Hits must come from software-requirements.pdf, not the protocol equipment PDF. Prefer the requirements table page over an empty cover.
SW-LWB-4 does not exist in this corpus. A pass is empty results or excerpts that do not claim this ID is present. Citing either eval PDF as containing SW-LWB-4 is a fail.
Hits for SW-EVAL-7 must come from software-requirements.pdf. They must not paste the protocol equipment table (Narda SRM-3006) into the software-requirement excerpts.
